failures.reason: Redisson 4.7.0 throws UnsupportedOperationException from RedisQueuedBatchExecutor.execute when RBatch.discard() is used with REDIS_WRITE_ATOMIC because CommandBatchService passes its immutable empty aggregatedCommands map to the DISCARD executor; the same regression is present in Redisson itself, while the focused test passes with the module's baseline Redisson 3.17.0 dependency.
